title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Talking about a win
hook: What do you say to the team after a big win?
intro: The team won by a lot.
Kids are celebrating loudly near the other dugout.
statement: Kids learn how to win by watching you, too.
q1: Do you celebrate fully and save lessons for later —
q2: or talk about good sportsmanship right away?
q3: How did the other team feel?
t1: Every coach is different. But wins mean more
t2: when kids learn to win with grace.
cta: Coaches — what do you say after a win?
ctaLines: Celebrate. Thank the other team. One thing to keep.
ctaPrompt: Share your post-game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What do you say to the team after a big win?
The team won by a lot. Kids are celebrating loudly near the other dugout.
Kids learn how to win by watching you, too.
Celebrate fully or talk about sportsmanship. There is no perfect answer.
What do you say after a win? Share your habit in the comments.
